name: Summon Heroes [Anime🎌]
desc:
Summon your team of Heroes and help save the worlds of Summonia!

This game is in BETA! Data will not be reset - but expect changes to be made.

🎃 HAPPY HALLOWEEN, NEW BATTLEPASS OUT NOW

✨ Summon over 60 different heroes.
🌎 Play 12 Story mode worlds.
⚔️ Compete in PvP & the Tournament.
👹 Gather Runes in Nightmare Dungeons!
🎪 Fight in the Nightmare Circus for rewards!
🚨Compete in the Endless Tower for Gear!

MAX LEVEL: 200

Join our communities and let us know what you want to see next! 🤝
